assertion.rationale: F9: because audit-log collection is entirely absent (3.3.1) and no individual action can be traced (3.3.2), no correlation of audit review, analysis and reporting for investigation of suspicious activity is possible in this estate — you cannot alert on, or correlate, data you never collect. This collapses detection (3.6) and incident-response-adjacent controls (3.14.6/.7) downstream of the same gap.

recommendation: Same collection fix as 3.3.1/3.3.2, plus raise lawDataRetentionDays from 30 to 90 (platform/main.bicep:91-93) to meet the AU-11 convention and DFARS 252.204-7012(e)'s 90-day preservation obligation, so correlated review and investigation has a sufficient window of data to work against.
